takeaway: Protracted vomiting loses hydrochloric acid from the stomach, leaving bicarbonate in the blood: a metabolic alkalosis. Aspirin, a pancreatic fistula and hypoglycaemia cause acidosis; hyperventilation, a respiratory alkalosis.
